FIFA 19 - Legacy Edition.name: FIFA 19: Legacy Edition
FIFA 19 - Legacy Edition.summary: FIFA 19 Legacy Edition launched on September 28th on PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360, featuring the latest kits, clubs, and squads from top leagues around the world. Gameplay features and modes have parity with FIFA 18 and FIFA 17 for these platforms.

Guided Fate Paradox, The.name: The Guided Fate Paradox
Guided Fate Paradox, The.summary:
God has never had it so rough!
Meet Renya, who happened to become God through a lottery. And then, his self-proclaimed personal angel named Lilliel took him to Celestia right away.
Together, they will tackle countless randomly-generated dungeons in this story-driven rogue-like RPG in order to guide the fate of all mankind to a revolution!
Fight, grow strong, customize your appearance, strengthen your equipment, and then fight some more. The only limit to your strength is your imagination!

SingStar Pop Edition.name: SingStar: Pop Edition
SingStar Pop Edition.summary: SingStar Pop Edition is a karaoke game featuring pop songs from the last thirty years and is the first to use the Voice Control, allowing players to jump to their favorite song by saying the name of the artist or the title of the song in the microphone.

Warriors Orochi 3.name: Warriors Orochi 3
Warriors Orochi 3.summary: Warriors Orochi 3, is a 2011 hack and slash video game. It is the fourth installment of the crossover series Warriors Orochi, a combination of the Dynasty Warriors and Samurai Warriors series. Play as a range of characters across multiple modes.
